title: Deer with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M32 28 Q28 18 22 12' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 24 Q24 22 19 20' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 20 Q26 14 28 10' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 28 Q72 18 78 12' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 24 Q76 22 81 20' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 20 Q74 14 72 10' stroke='#c0842a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='38' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#d4923a' transform='rotate(-25 24 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='38' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b97a' transform='rotate(-25 24 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='38' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#d4923a' transform='rotate(25 76 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='38' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b97a' transform='rotate(25 76 38)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#c8823a'/>
  <!-- forehead patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#e8a95a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#f0c98a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f2b0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f2b0a0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='50' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#5a2d0c'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='50' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#5a2d0c'/>
  <!-- sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='47' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='52' r='1' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='2.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='1.4' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='1' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#7a3d12'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='60' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#b06a30'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 67 Q50 71 54 67' stroke='#9a4f1a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- neck / body hint -->
  <path d='M38 74 Q50 82 62 74 L58 86 Q50 92 42 86 Z' fill='#c8823a'/>
</svg>
